review_material.assessment: The source provides the exact defect supersymmetric Rényi entropy formula for 6d A_(N-1) 1/2-BPS Wilson surfaces with r1=r2=1/2, including explicit expressions for b and d2 in symmetric and antisymmetric representations. The selected cluster is fully supported by lines 101-116 and 140-144, with the r1=r2=1/2 specialization from line 333. The formula is linear in gamma=1/n and valid for gamma>0, N>=3, 2<=k<=N-1 as per the representation constraints. The extraction is complete and case_authoring_ready is true.

review_material.paper_scope: The paper derives closed-form expressions for the contribution of surface defects to supersymmetric Rényi entropy and Casimir energy in 6d (2,0) theories, expressed in terms of defect Weyl anomaly coefficients b and d2. The main result is the defect SRE formula S_gamma = (2b - d2)/6 * [r1 r2/2 (gamma - 1) + 1] log(ell/epsilon), with explicit b and d2 for symmetric and antisymmetric representations of A_(N-1). The paper also covers holographic large-N checks, localization results, and anomaly polynomial derivations.
